dedupe_keys.name: thermal properties of building materials reusable appendix database

description: This appendix database collects thermophysical properties of common construction and building materials and material choices for indoor contents and furniture. Aalborg University publishes the spreadsheet alongside the 2021 technical report Thermal properties of building materials: Review and database. The university landing page identifies a separate Excel appendix, its size and its CC BY-SA 4.0 licence, establishing a reusable data object beyond the report. Access is public and free. The material-property compilation is not a geographically sampled infrastructure inventory or a time series; the relevant period is the 2021 publication, and individual measurement origins and units were not inspected inside the spreadsheet. A limitation is that the landing-page abstract does not expose the complete property dictionary, uncertainty estimates or temperature conditions for each material. These must be checked before assigning simulation parameters. Simulation uses include selecting thermal-envelope and internal-content parameters for building-energy models. It relates to model-energyplus as a possible consumer after appropriate unit and material mapping; compatibility was not tested. The report DOI remains a citation identifier, not a separate dataset DOI. Neither the spreadsheet nor report PDF was downloaded. The property compilation has no stated geographic coverage or common measurement period.
